items.title: Introducing context-aware rules for AWS Network Firewall
items.summary: AWS Network Firewall now supports context-aware rules, which match traffic by the AWS resources that send and receive it instead of by IP address. A rule can name a virtual private cloud (VPC), a subnet, a security group, or a transit gateway attachment. Rules that match on IP addresses have to keep up with every […]

items.title: Introducing AWS Network Firewall Next Generation policy
items.summary: When it comes to inspecting network traffic, many security teams want two things from a firewall. They want to allow only the traffic each application needs, and they want each allowed connection checked for known threats. Today, you can do both with AWS Network Firewall, a stateful, managed network firewall and intrusion detection and prevention […]
